modules.title: Invoice and voyage intake
modules.nextAction: Parse bounded CSV and a canonical JSON form, normalize amounts as integer minor units, require voyage, terminal and invoice identity, and preserve file provenance.

modules.title: Tariff clock and day ledger
modules.nextAction: Model effective tariff versions, terminal-local dates, rate tiers, exception calendars and explicit start/end inclusion. Make each day independently inspectable.

modules.title: Evidence graph and uncertainty
modules.nextAction: Attach signed or authenticated source records to events; identify conflicts and bounded gaps and compute alternative valid charge outcomes.

modules.title: Quote and scoped acquisition
modules.nextAction: Capture quote, price asset, expiry, permitted seller and redistribution rights. Require an applicable case budget, an auditable comparison and a Kite-compatible payment route before dispatch.

modules.title: Partner reconciliation
modules.nextAction: Implement authenticated retrieval or callbacks with idempotency, provenance hashes, unknown-order handling and selective retry. Add manual conflict resolution and a reason trail.

modules.title: Analyst casebook and export
modules.nextAction: Build a keyboard-accessible invoice/day comparison and evidence panel. Export review-approved calculations and licensed attachments with a case manifest.

modules.title: Credit posting and portfolio reporting
modules.nextAction: Record referenced credits against invoice lines and expose disputed, submitted where manually evidenced, and credited amounts across active cases, with per-currency subtotals.

modules.title: End-to-end operator replay
modules.nextAction: Exercise import, governed data acquisition, late correction, exported artifacts and accounting through normal user surfaces; provide a licensed pilot-fixture intake path.
